name: Dubai International Airport

runway.v: two parallel runways; the longer, 12R/30L, is 4,447 m long and 60 m wide (12L/30R is 4,351 m x 60 m)

hours.v: open 24 hours, with air traffic services, fuel and handling 24 hours
hours.quote: AD Administration: H24 ... Air Traffic Services: H24 ... Handling: H24

slots.v: a fully slot-coordinated (IATA level 3) airport: no flight without a slot from the slot coordinator (Airport Coordination Limited, ACL) and landing permission from the Dubai Civil Aviation Authority
slots.quote: OMDB operates as an IATA level 3 slot coordinated airport. No operator shall operate to or from OMDB without first obtaining an allocated slot from Airport Coordination Limited (ACL)

handling.v: Jet Aviation and ExecuJet are the only FBOs handling general aviation; operators must contract one of them, and slot requests go through the FBO
handling.quote: Jet Aviation and Execujet Aviation Group are the sole FBOs providing ground handling services for GA aircraft at the Airport.

max_aircraft.v: the largest aircraft (code F) must apply for schedule clearance at least 72 hours before arrival
max_aircraft.quote: must apply for schedule clearance at least seventy-two (72) hours prior to the intended arrival

noise.v: except for passenger flights, aircraft without ICAO Annex 16 noise certification (Chapter 3 minimum) may not operate to or from Dubai International
noise.quote: Except for passenger operations, aircraft not in possession of noise certification in accordance with the standards of Annex 16 to the ICAO ... are not permitted to operate to/from OMDB.

permits.v: every GA flight needs landing permission from the Dubai Civil Aviation Authority (DCAA), applied for through its online portal, as well as an ACL slot; proof of the permit is sent to Dubai Airports' operations centre
permits.quote: No GA Operator is permitted to operate to or from the Airport without first obtaining landing permission from the DCAA
